definitions.d: D*b computed offchain with unbounded integers
definitions.p: B*s computed offchain with unbounded integers
definitions.q: Actual base token balance increase returned by doTransferIn, not necessarily submitted token spend.

edge_cases: Successive floors equal division by the product of positive divisors.
Because s>=1, final p*q<=U also enforces the earlier B*q intermediate for positive q.
If mathematical p>U, no positive q fits; q=0 does not execute a standalone B*s multiplication.
If mathematical d>U, every checked numerator gives C=0; source never multiplies D*b, so this fact alone is not denominator overflow.
The pre-transfer reserves gate does not imply q<=target-reserves. There is no post-transfer target cap in the inspected purchase body.
If discounted price is zero or an upstream checked computation fails, the quote is unavailable; these formulas do not cure that failure.
limitations: This is an exact conditional integer bound for the inspected source body only. Token behavior, returned values, future state, proxy/dependency binding, fee/gas and executable cash exit remain unresolved. No source-equivalence or economic claim.
review: Root read the pinned official source through the browser; independent Sol first confirmed the algebra alone, then confirmed it under the exact source operation order supplied by root. No source-body file, source compilation, live call or numeric economic input was created.
source_operations: The source multiplies B by q, then s, then divides by D and b. buyCollateral checks pause and reserves before transfer, then quote, min output, stock and safe128 before transfer out. Upstream price/discount and transfer success are separate prerequisites.
